You can scan QR Code patterns to load other
players’ Secret Bases.
When you scan a QR Code, you will load the
layout for another player’s Secret Base and
the brief message they entered.
Do you want to continue?

You can create a QR Code for your own
Secret Base.
This QR Code will contain data for your Secret
Base’s layout and the message you entered.
The QR Code you create can be saved on
the SD Card in your Nintendo 3DS system.

Please line up the QR Code within the green
square on the upper screen and press the
A Button.
